requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:72-74 reads the mention footer and truncates the body to MaxContentLength - mb_strlen($footer) before appending it, so the whole content stays <=1800 and the mention survives; :80-91 returns '' for anything that is not a string/int or does not match /\A[0-9]{17,20}\z/ after trim(); :90 emits "\n<@{$id}>". config/services.php:40 and .env.example:78-79 add services.discord.mention_id / DISCORD_MENTION_ID; docs/ops/devops.md:72,75 and docs/ops/logging.md:83 document it. With an empty footer the expression is identical to the old mb_substr(..., 0, 1800), so existing behaviour is unchanged.

conventions.evidence: Ships Pest feature tests in tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:125-222 (no production code without a test), updates CHANGELOG.md:12 under [Unreleased], and keeps ops docs in sync (docs/ops/devops.md, docs/ops/logging.md). security.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:29,88-90 validates the configured id with anchored /\A[0-9]{17,20}\z/ after trim(); the anchors reject embedded newlines and extra characters such as "123\n@everyone" and "123> \n@everyone", and non-string/non-int values are ignored (:84-86). The emitted footer contains only digits, so the setting cannot inject mention markup or @everyone/@here. No new user-facing endpoint, authorization, or output escaping surface is introduced.

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php:125-139 asserts the mention is appended on its own line; :141-160 covers integer, whitespace-padded, minimum (17) and maximum (20) digits; :162-176 covers null/empty/whitespace-only; :178-206 rejects @everyone, @here, abc, 123, 16/21 digits, full-width digits, negatives, newline payloads and a pre-wrapped mention; :208-222 verifies the 1800-character total with the mention preserved after truncation. These cover the happy path and the required failure/abuse paths.

simplicity.evidence: The production change is a single private mentionFooter() helper (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:80-91) plus reserving mb_strlen($footer) in the existing mb_substr call (:72-74); it reuses config/services and the existing content builder with no new abstraction or duplication.

readability.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:59-72 has a focused method with a docblock, named MentionIdPattern constant, early return for non-scalar values, and a single readable ternary; the truncation expression at :74 clearly states the reserved-room intent and matches the surrounding style.

scope.evidence: The diff touches only task-relevant files: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php, config/services.php, .env.example, docs/ops/devops.md, docs/ops/logging.md, tests/Feature/DiscordOpsAlertTest.php, plus the convention-mandated CHANGELOG.md:12 entry. review.summary: The change adds a configurable Discord user mention to every ops alert, validating the id as a 17-20 digit snowflake, rejecting invalid/newline payloads, and reserving room for the footer inside the 1800-character limit while leaving the no-mention path byte-for-byte equivalent. It is covered by meaningful Pest tests for the happy path, boundary and invalid ids, empties, and truncation, and updates .env.example, the ops docs and the changelog. I found no blockers or nits that would need changes.
